_comment: The size study's data block (STUDY.md 3.1-3.3; kitsune/prereg.py pre-registers it). Every study run config carries these keys verbatim: vast/launch.py checks the selection against sources, eval_sets, extent and selection_recipe (its study block included), and kitsune.extent.pull_plan pulls both label roots for every run (pull_parakeet). The selection is built once, on the laptop CPU, from the sealed labels/full pulled to the repo root: python scripts/make_selection.py --config study/data.json --skip-audio-check (the A100 rebuild checks the audio ids against extent.json). extent.inputs.reazon_large is set at the pre-launch commit to the smallest N whose pool after all filters holds >= 1,010 h (the sidecar's details.pool_hours_if_capped); 50 until the labels are sealed. The trainer does not read this file; before a trainer config may carry pull_parakeet and selection_recipe.study, scripts/04_distill.py DEFAULTS needs them (pull_parakeet false, selection_recipe.study null).
